subject: Executive signoff request: Sideload credit structure for SynthoHealth pilot
messages:
From: Emma Carter <emma@synthohealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood Dedicated pilot — request for sideload credit structure

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at SynthoHealth is excited about Dedicated for our inference-heavy cleansing pipeline. Before we move to procurement, our CFO has asked if Redwood can support a small ‘sideload credit’ on top of the pilot commitment: 100k token credits usable for burst/overage in other regions for the first 90 days.

Key ask: 30% effective discount on the first 250k tokens (applied as a credit pool, not per-request). In exchange we commit to a 12‑month preferred partnership (annual renewal, 18% committed compute uplift after pilot).

This is time-sensitive — our procurement window closes end of next week. Can you confirm feasibility and any executive approvals needed?

Attachments: syntho-pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx (proposal)

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Carter | Head of Infrastructure
SynthoHealth
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Emma Carter <emma@synthohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Dedicated pilot — request for sideload credit structure

Hi Emma — appreciate the clear ask and the terms. Looping in Marissa (commercial lead) and Kim (finance) to run impact. High level: the sideload credit as a pooled, region-agnostic burst credit is technically doable, but the 30% effective discount on first 250k tokens is outside standard guardrails for pilot pricing.

Marissa / Kim — can you run a quick P&L on: (a) effective revenue delta for Q3/Q4; (b) mechanism (credit + expiry) and whether we need VP/CFO signoff; (c) recommended approval language if we greenlight (e.g., one-time onboarding credit vs. structured ramp). I’ve added the Syntho proposal.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart | Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Redwood Dedicated pilot — request for sideload credit structure (internal memo)

Team — I ran a modeled impact (see attached internal-approval-memo.docx). TL;DR:
- If we accept a 30% effective discount applied as a 250k token credit pool, the one-time gross revenue reduction is ~$18k over the pilot.
- Upside: 12-month preferred partnership gives expected ARR uplift of $220k NPV over 12 months (conservative churn).
- Risk: credit is region-agnostic; we should limit cross-region egress to avoid wholesale margin erosion. Suggested guardrails: credit expires after 90 days, caps to 100k tokens per region, and overage billed at standard committed rate.

Recommendation: seek VP/CFO signoff to approve a one-time sideload credit of 250k tokens at 30% effective off list for the initial 90-day pilot, contingent on (1) signed 12‑month preferred partnership and (2) a bump to guaranteed committed spend of 18% compared to pilot.

Proposed approval language to send to leadership: "Approve a one-time, non-recurring sideload credit of up to 250,000 tokens at a 30% effective discount for SynthoHealth’s 90‑day pilot. Credit is region-capped, expires 90 days post-activation, and requires a 12‑month preferred commitment to unlock the credit."

Attaching the customer sheet and the internal memo. If Aditya signs off, I’ll draft the commercial amendment and legal term sheet (mop-sideload-term-sheet.pdf).

— Marissa
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: SynthoHealth sideload credit (conditions)

Thanks all for the diligence. I approve the one-time sideload credit under these non-negotiable conditions:
1) Credit is strictly non-transferable and expires after 90 days from activation.
2) Per-region cap set to 100k tokens to avoid cross-region arbitrage.
3) Signed 12‑month MSA addendum with a minimum committed spend (as Marissa modeled).
4) Legal to include an overage clause at standard Dedicated rates plus 20% premium for any tokens consumed beyond the credit pool.
5) We will not apply the same concession to other customers without VP-level review.

Marissa — please confirm the amendment language and add an executive summary to the HubSpot deal. Finance will record an $18k one-time reduction against Q3 bookings.

Aditya
Chief Revenue Officer (acting signatory)
Redwood Inference
From: Emma Carter <emma@synthohealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: SynthoHealth Procurement <procurement@synthohealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 17:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Dedicated pilot — request for sideload credit structure

Evelyn / Marissa — this is great, thanks for the quick turnaround and the clarity on conditions. We accept the 90-day expiry and region caps; procurement will review the MSA addendum and confirm by Friday.

Next steps I have: sign amended MSA, activate pilot, provide account-level telemetry for onboarding. I'll drop the signed LOI once procurement completes the internal review.

Appreciate the help — Emma
